class.name: OcgBrepmeshFacechecker
class.brief_description: Auxiliary class checking wires of target face for self-intersections. Explodes wires of discrete face on sets of segments using tessellation data stored in model. Each segment is then checked for intersection with other ones. All collisions are registered and returned as result of check.
